Each category has three bars corresponding to the different measures: Überwachtes Kupfer Preis (World copper price index), Goldmärkte (Gold market growth), and Industrieproduktion Deutschland (German industry production index). The bars are color-coded to differentiate between the measures, with the specific colors and patterns not identified.
